description: This Java source file 'SearchModelJsonExamplesProducer' creates sample JSON data for search results and authorization contexts, primarily for testing or example purposes in the 'thingsearch' module of the project.

classes.name: SearchModelJsonExamplesProducer
classes.description: A utility class with a main method that generates sample JSON files demonstrating search results and authorization context data.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main method to generate JSON files; expects a single argument specifying the target directory.
